RegisterStatus.description_en:
The registration status. Valid values:

0: Registration failed. Possible reasons include inconsistency between qualification information and MIIT registration information, or the carrier does not support the registration. Log on to the Short Message Service console (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign) to view the specific failure reason and follow the instructions.
1: Registered and pending verification. At least one sub-port number has been approved by the carrier. Send verification codes or notification messages in small batches to phone numbers of different carriers for verification.
2: Registration expired. The signature has had no sending records for more than 6 months, causing the registration to expire. To re-enable the signature, re-initiate registration in the Short Message Service console (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign).
3: Registration succeeded. At least one sub-port number has been approved by the carrier, and the SMS delivery success rate meets expectations after verification. Continue to monitor the delivery success rate.
-1: Registration in progress. No registration result has been received from the carrier. Wait until the registration status changes to "Registered and pending verification" before sending in bulk. You can send small batches using this signature to observe the delivery results.
-2: Not registered. Possible reasons include the signature not being associated with a real-name qualification or incomplete qualification information. Modify the current qualification or edit the signature to bind another qualification to re-initiate registration.

Click to view [more information about signature real-name registration and suggested actions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2873145.html）
RegisterStatus.description_zh:
报备状态。取值：

0：报备失败，原因可能为资质信息与工信注册信息不一致或运营商侧无法支持等。建议您登录短信服务控制台 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign)查看具体失败原因，并依据提示进行操作；
1：已报备待验证，当前至少有一个子端口号运营商已返回报备通过，建议您少量多次向不同运营商手机号发送验证码、通知短信进行验证；
2：报备失效，签名超过 6 个月无发送记录时，报备结果失效。如您需要重新启用该签名，请在短信服务控制台 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign)重新发起报备；
3：报备成功，当前至少有一个子端口号运营商已返回报备通过，经验证短信发送成功率符合预期，建议您持续关注发送成功率；
-1：报备中，当前尚未收到运营商反馈的报备结果，建议您等待签名报备状态变更为“已报备待验证”后再批量发送，当前可少量多次尝试使用该签名发送，观察短信发送效果；
-2：未报备，原因可能为当前签名未关联实名资质或关联资质信息不全，建议您修改当前资质或编辑签名绑定其他资质以重新发起报备。

建议您单击查看[更多签名实名制报备内容及建议操作]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2873145.html）

RegisterStatusReasons.description_en: The list of registration status reasons

ReasonCode.description_en:
The registration status reason code. Valid values:
UNBINDING_QUA: The signature is not associated with a qualification.
BINDING_INCOMPLETE_QUA: The associated qualification information is incomplete.
NON_REGISTER: Registration has not been initiated.
REGISTERING: Signature registration in progress.
DETECTING: Detection has not been initiated or is in progress.
DETECT_SUCCESS: Registration succeeded.
QUALIFICATION_ERROR: Qualification issue.
SIGNATURE_ERROR: Signature issue.
SIGNATURE_QUALIFICATION_ERROR: The signature does not match the qualification.
ONE_CODE_MULTIPLE_SIGN: Extension code issue.
OTHERS_ERROR: Other reasons.
REGISTER_TIMEOUT: Registration timed out.
NO_SEND_RECORD: The signature has had no sending records for more than 6 months.
EXT_CODE_RECYCLE: The extension code was reclaimed.
SUBPORT_RECYCLE: The sub-port was reclaimed by the carrier
ReasonCode.description_zh:
报备状态原因码。取值：
UNBINDING_QUA：签名未关联资质；
BINDING_INCOMPLETE_QUA：关联资质信息不全；
NON_REGISTER：未发起报备；
REGISTERING：签名报备中；
DETECTING：未发起探测或探测中；
DETECT_SUCCESS：报备成功；
QUALIFICATION_ERROR：资质原因；
SIGNATURE_ERROR：签名原因；
SIGNATURE_QUALIFICATION_ERROR：签名与资质关系不符；
ONE_CODE_MULTIPLE_SIGN：扩展码原因；
OTHERS_ERROR：其他原因；
REGISTER_TIMEOUT：报备超时；
NO_SEND_RECORD：签名超过6个月无发送记录；
EXT_CODE_RECYCLE：扩展码收回。
SUBPORT_RECYCLE：子端口被运营商治理

ReasonDescList.description_en: The list of reason descriptions. Zero or more reason descriptions may be returned. A reason code does not necessarily have a corresponding reason description
ReasonDescList.description_zh: 原因说明列表。可能返回0个或者多个原因说明，返回原因码不一定会返回原因说明

1: approved.
